slides.heading: R1 — Storage locations
slides.note: Configuring logical locations enables accurate store-to-kitchen tracking.
steps: Open Settings and select Inventory tab.
Access Storage locations.
Create designated storage zones (Main Store, Kitchen, Bar, Walk-in, Pastry).
Set temperature or zone tags if supported.
Save storage locations for use in transfers and receiving.

slides.heading: R2 — Yield conversions
slides.note: Yield formulas ensure realistic inventory depletion during bulk food prep.
steps: Open Yield conversions under Inventory settings.
Link raw bulk items to prepped kitchen ingredients.
Set yield conversion factor (e.g. Whole chicken > Cleaned chicken breast).
Account for trimming, cooking, or butcher waste percentages.
Save conversion formulas for kitchen prep batches.

slides.heading: R3 — Stock receiving
slides.note: Stock counts only increase upon formal Stock Receiving confirmation.
steps: Open Stock receiving when vendor deliveries arrive.
Select delivering vendor or link existing Purchase Order.
Inspect items and enter verified quantities received.
Record invoice number, batch date, and unit cost.
Confirm receiving to immediately update on-hand stock quantities.

slides.heading: R4 — Stock transfer
slides.note: Never record transfers in system without executing physical movement.
steps: Open Stock transfer screen.
Select source location / branch (e.g. Main Store).
Select destination location / branch (e.g. Kitchen or Bar).
Add transfer items and enter physical movement quantities.
Confirm transfer and verify inventory updates at both locations.

slides.heading: R5 — Purchase Order (PO)
slides.note: POs provide a clear audit trail for purchasing commitments and costs.
steps: Open Purchase Orders module.
Create new PO for authorized food vendor.
Add required items, reorder quantities, and expected delivery date.
Save and issue PO via PDF or email to vendor.
Receive goods against the PO upon warehouse delivery.

slides.heading: R6 — Stock Master (On-Hand)
slides.note: Periodic physical inventory counts verify actual versus theoretical stock.
steps: Open Stock Master from main navigation.
Search items by category, vendor, or storage location.
Review real-time on-hand stock quantities and inventory valuation.
Perform stock adjustments only with manager approval (spoilage, count variance).
Enter mandatory adjustment reason for inventory audits.
